questions: Run by a Thailand- and Mexico-based organization and ranked among beauty pageantry's 'Big Four,' this contest crowned Mexico's Fátima Bosch as its reigning titleholder in November 2025 — which pageant?
Miss Universe: Annual international beauty pageant competition.

A functional gastrointestinal disorder characterized by abdominal pain, bloating, and changes in bowel movement consistency over long periods, sometimes years, it can negatively affect quality of life and is associated with anxiety and depression. What condition is this?
Irritable bowel syndrome: Functional gastrointestinal disorder. The cause of IBS is not known but multiple factors have been proposed to lead to the condition.

In the 2017-18 Eredivisie season, this Iranian winger scored 21 league goals to become the first Asian player ever to top the scoring charts in a major European league. Who is he?
Alireza Jahanbakhsh (born 11 August 1993) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a winger for the Iran national team.
